summary: HTTP registry setup: set DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR, download 'Ansible self-service automation portal Setup Bundle' (self-service-automation-portal-plugins-x.y.z.tar.gz) from the AAP 2.6 Product Software downloads, extract with tar --exclude='*code*', check the rhaap and scaffolder .tgz plus .integrity files, then oc new-build httpd --name=plugin-registry --binary, oc start-build --from-dir and oc new-app.
questions: How do I build the portal plug-in registry with httpd?
Where do I download the self-service automation portal setup bundle?
What files are in the portal plug-ins tarball?

answer_card.title: Build the HTTP plug-in registry
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
export DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR=/path/to/plugins
# download self-service-automation-portal-plugins-x.y.z.tar.gz
# (AAP 2.6 Product Software downloads)
tar --exclude='*code*' -xzf self-service-automation-portal-plugins-x.y.z.tar.gz -C $DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR
ls $DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR   # rhaap + scaffolder .tgz and .integrity files
oc new-build httpd --name=plugin-registry --binary
oc start-build plugin-registry --from-dir=$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR --wait
oc new-app --image-stream=plugin-registry
```
The `.integrity` files hold each plug-in's SHA. Then set `redhat-developer-hub.global.pluginMode: tarball`.
